about: Cell text: each float column's budget as the GPUI contender laid it out (its ColumnProbe); values from the data file with the exact text and the shown text the contender drew (cells, written by apps/observatory/perf/cell-fixture.ts); synthetic values the same columns round (rounding, kept by it); with resize, GPUI's widest number advance (number_px) and widths with the budgets they give (resize, both kept by it); with format, the characters' advances and formatted cases (format, kept by it); a TIMESTAMP's text as live tail draws it (timestamp_text, hand-written, kept by it); and each scenario but the asteroids its own columns and cells, drawn at its default stop (scenarios; a file of text alone, every column as text). See README.md.

source.contender: tall-table-gpui, release build, Chromium, 2560x900 at DPR 2 (budgets the same at DPR 1)

rounding.why: rounded text is never the same float
rounding carries past the budget: scientific
a whole part too long: scientific
plain while it keeps 3 digits or more
a tie rounds to even (JS's toFixed rounds it up)
two shortest texts equally near: the exact text takes the upper (JS's String takes the even)

widths.why: below the min: clamped up to it
past the max: clamped down to it

cells.why: at the min, the magnitude alone (wider than its budget: GPUI cuts it)
narrowed: decimals cut to the budget
narrowed: an integer part past the budget goes to exponent form
narrowed: a small value goes to exponent form
widened: a value rounded at the kind's width shown whole

format.about: A number column's format (format): each character a format writes, its advance in CSS px at the cells' 14 px IBM Plex Sans (advances; pinned from Chromium with the bare host: just tall-table format-fixture), and cases: a format, a kind, a value, a page's decimals (null for the column's), a set width → the exact text, the shown text, whether it fell back to the automatic format, and whether the format rounded it (the tooltip; null for a fallback, judged as the base's text). See README.md.

cases.why: an exact tie at 2 rounds to even (toFixed writes 1.13)
0.005 is just above half in binary: 0.01 (V8's Intl writes 0.00)
rounds to zero: the sign is the raw value's
rounds to zero below: the minus kept
an exact zero, -0.0 too, takes no sign
an exact zero with Always: no +
a decimal whose digits are all zero: its written minus dropped
a Float32 dressed: 9.420 reads back as the f32 9.42, so no tooltip
no decimals: the exact text grouped, a whole float's .0 kept
no decimals: an exponent keeps its form, never grouped
no decimals: a plain exact text grouped on its whole digits
a suffix wider than a digit (% 12.978 px): fits by advances, not by count
a pixel short (66.416 px of 66): the automatic format at the column's budget
an integer too wide: its plain text (cut in the middle where it doesn't fit)
a decimal's text grouped, its digits as written
the canvas's Last under 10: the page's 3

timestamp_text.about: A zoneless TIMESTAMP (live tail's `time`: the log's wall time, −0400, no zone) as the log wrote it: two-digit day, the English month's three letters, four-digit year, a space, 24-hour HH:MM:SS, no fraction (cut, not rounded): `13/Jul/1995 03:14:02`, 20 characters. `micros` is the value from the epoch, as Arrow holds a microsecond timestamp, read as UTC (never through a local-time conversion, so a visitor's zone changes nothing). Run by the GPUI contender's `src/tail.rs` and the TanStack contender's `test/tail.test.ts`, with controls: an unpadded day, a numeric month, a local-time conversion.

cases.why: the file's last row (and lap 1's first: the seam's time repeats, never runs back)
the canvas's row in lap 7, into 1996
lap 32's first row, past the soak's reach, in 1997
a fraction of a second, dropped
